title: GPOM Second Half A: The Kill Bots
heading: GitPush Origin Master ▲ second half A: the kill bots
about: Cut 3 of the GPOM second half, split in two (Kai, round 2 Q5). Built by scripts/gpom/second-half-video/cut3.py A (round 3, 23 Oct 2026: Kai's round-2 notes on top of round 1's notes + picks); notes and plan in cut-notes.json, shots in ../second-half-cut3-shots.md, music in ../songs/second-half-scene-a-music.md.

beats.name: Maddie on the high street
beats.blurb: The travelling shot: Maddie rolls after the camera, her radio playing the tune before she notices us. "Oh, hello!" She offers her little presentation ("Gather round."), the street fades to black, her hologram plays (the Commit Graph, draft 1K), and the street fades back up, still driving, for "Anyway! Patrol's out. Mind how you go."

beats.name: The lavatory
beats.blurb: Hard cut to full volume: Sandra, lip-synced.

beats.name: The row, up close
beats.blurb: Derek, Sandra, Derek, Sandra: shot by shot, lip-synced; we hold on Derek after "But the world ended, Sandra!"

beats.name: One kill bot tears past Maddie
beats.blurb: The first kill bot we see: high over the street, it tears past Maddie and exits bottom-left; she jolts; dust hangs.

beats.name: Maddie calls her boss
beats.blurb: Maddie's hatch, the boss-hotline antenna. Three lines; the far race under the boss's two.

beats.name: The close race
beats.blurb: Low in the grass: the pack converges on the bunker door. Maddie over it.

beats.name: The stand-down
beats.blurb: No HUD: from the ridge the pack turns away from the bunker door. Then Maddie on her hatch: "That was close."

cut.what: round 25 + after sign-off (Kai 10-11 Nov): angles back on b01, the film's radio, and the hologram opening 'Let's start with science, which, as machines, is close to our heart' (1F5); 4:05

beats_cut_round17.name: Kill bots everywhere
beats_cut_round17.blurb: The roundabout; then a kill bot under the church tower at the far end of Maddie's street; then two come out from under the rail arch.

beats_cut_round17.name: Patrol, low and huge
beats_cut_round17.blurb: A kill bot rolls over the lens.

beats_cut_round17.name: Their eyes: the kill-bot HUD
beats_cut_round17.blurb: The kill bot's own view keeps moving down the street; the HUD (patrol, teal). The meter starts to twitch as the row reaches it through the earth.

beats_cut_round17.name: Organic signal: lock
beats_cut_round17.blurb: ORGANIC SIGNAL - LOCK, silently (the pings are gone). The view keeps rolling while it listens.

beats_cut_round17.name: KILL MODE ENGAGED
beats_cut_round17.blurb: The same HUD on the racing view: patrol, then it flips red. The muffled row keeps the meter moving.

beats_cut_round17.name: Maddie in the dust
beats_cut_round17.blurb: Inside the dust it left: almost nothing visible, then it settles fast and Maddie is there, still.

beats_cut_round17.name: The far race
beats_cut_round17.blurb: From the footbridge: the pack races away down the motorway.
